definition.simple: A bunch of different things mixed together that can still be separated, like a bowl of mixed nuts.
definition.academic: A material made up of two or more different substances which are physically combined but not chemically bonded.

common_misconceptions: Thinking that mixtures are always liquids or always solids.
Confusing solutions (which are mixtures) with compounds.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask if they can separate the ingredients in lemonade or bhel puri easily compared to separating hydrogen from water.
